hero.title: Everything you're wondering about Breathe
hero.subtitle: How the rhythms work, what backgrounds are available, and how your data stays on your device.
tabs.title: Three things people ask about most
tab-1.label: Rhythms
tab-1.title: How do the breathing rhythms work?
tab-1.body: Each preset sets an inhale and exhale duration, like the 4/6 second Relax rhythm. A pulsing circle on screen shows you exactly when to breathe in and out, so there's nothing to count.
tab-2.label: Backgrounds
tab-2.title: What backgrounds can I use?
tab-2.body: Choose from video atmospheres like Beach, River, Fireplace, Earth, and Space, or photo atmospheres like Seashore and Rainforest. Everything downloads once so it works fully offline.
tab-3.label: Privacy
tab-3.title: Does Breathe track my data?
tab-3.body: No. Breathe has no accounts, no analytics, and no ad SDKs. Your rhythm and background choices stay on your device.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
item-1.title: Is Breathe free?
item-1.body: Yes, Breathe is free on both iOS and Android with no account required.
item-2.title: Does it work without internet?
item-2.body: Yes, once a background downloads it's stored on your device for fully offline sessions.
item-3.title: Can I create a custom rhythm?
item-3.body: Yes, you can set your own inhale and exhale timing instead of using a preset.
item-4.title: What languages does it support?
item-4.body: Breathe is available in 27 languages to support breathing practices worldwide.
item-5.title: How do I import my own media?
item-5.body: You can import backgrounds from your device library alongside the built-in atmospheres.
cta.title: Still have a question?
cta.body: Reach out any time. We'd love to hear from you.
